encodingDesc.p: The page image is authoritative. Hathi OCR and the 2014 XML are comparison witnesses only. Printed text is not silently corrected. Verse lines use numbered l elements. Citation hierarchy is author.work.fragment.line.

cRefPattern.p: This pointer pattern extracts lines within fragments.

revisionDesc.change: Split the volume-level OCR draft into canonical TLG author and work files. Running-head continuations were folded into their works; wording was not corrected. The page image remains authoritative and the transcription requires human review.

Etym. m. 167, 46 ὁ κωμικὸς δὲ χρονικὸν αὐτὸ (τὸ ἄττα) παραλαμβάνει πύθου χελιδὼν τηνίκ᾽ ἄττα γίνεται. λέγει, ὁπότε, χελιδὼν γίνεται. sine auctoris nomine Schol. Plat. 372, altero versu addito

quem ipsum quoque Chionidi tribuit Bergkius (Meinek. II 1181). cf. miracula Photii et Hesychii πυθοῦ χελιδόνος. Aristophanis esse Dindorfius arbitratur (Arist. fragm. p. 206). cf. Arist. fr. 601. 2 huiu sed. — ex Harpocrationis codicibus non maiore opera Διωξίππου quam Χιωνίδου eruas. sed omnino de nomine proprio restituendo dubito. quis enim praestet verba poetae non sic antiquitus scripta fuisse (ἐν μέσῳ) χει(μ)ῶνί που | πυθοῦ χελιδών κτλ. — versus alter ita fere interpretandus videtur: θαυμάζω δ᾽ ἐγώ, | ὁπηνίκ᾽ ἄτθ᾽ ὑμεῖς κτλ. verba πυθοῦ χελιδὼν πηνίκ᾽ ἄττα φαίνεται idem significare videntur ac πυθοῦ πηνίκ ἄττα χελιδών φαίνεται. adponam tamen insignem M. Hauptii adnotationem ex Herm.
